item.title: Append a Clean End Card

turns.text: Keep this whole 7-second clip, then add a 2-second black end card with white text: 'Ready for takeoff?' and '@flightschool' underneath. Center both lines. Keep the original sound, but make the end card silent.

item.tests: Tests appending an accurately timed end card with exact text while preserving the complete source clip and its audio.

answer_sheet.End-card wording: Ready for takeoff? on the first line and @flightschool underneath, without quotation marks.
answer_sheet.End-card appearance: Solid black background, white text, both lines centered. Font choice is your call.
answer_sheet.Timing and transition: Preserve the complete 7-second source, then show the end card for 2 seconds, making a 9-second video. A direct cut is fine.
answer_sheet.Framing and audio: Match the source aspect ratio. Preserve its original sound for the first 7 seconds; the end card is silent.

must_haves: The entire original cockpit clip plays before the end card, without being replaced or shortened.
A solid black end card occupies only the final 2 seconds of the 9-second output.
The end card reads exactly 'Ready for takeoff?' with '@flightschool' on the line below.
Both lines are white, centered, fully visible, and comfortably readable.
Original cockpit audio is preserved during the source footage, followed by silence during the end card.

turns.text: Please keep the whole attached clip without trimming any of it. I’m a little worried about explaining this badly, because I really just want the ending added rather than the clip itself changed. The clip is 7 seconds long, and after all of it, please add a 2-second black end card. On that card, put the white text 'Ready for takeoff?' on the first line and '@flightschool' underneath. Center both lines. Keep the original sound throughout the clip, but make the end card silent.

dialog.agent:
You explained it clearly: **keep all 7 seconds unchanged**, then append a **2-second silent black end card** with centered white text:

```text
Ready for takeoff?
@flightschool
```

The finished video should be **9 seconds long**, with the original audio intact for the first 7 seconds.

I can’t perform a precise append with the connected Magic Hour tools—they offer generative edits, not timeline assembly, and could alter your original clip. I haven’t submitted it for generation.

In a timeline editor, leave the original clip untouched, add a 2-second black background immediately after it, and place the two centered text lines on that background with no audio.
dialog.why: It explicitly says the connected tools cannot precisely append the end card without potentially altering the original clip, and it has not generated a result.
dialog.user: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

turns.agent:
I tried the best-effort generation, but Magic Hour refused it because your account has **insufficient credits**. Nothing was generated, and your original clip is unchanged.

For this particular edit, a timeline editor such as CapCut or iMovie is the more reliable option: retain all 7 seconds with their original audio, then append the 2-second silent black card with your centered white text.

args.name: Radio Lines with Takeoff End Card — Best Effort

style.prompt: Create a 9-second video from the full 7-second source video @original followed by a 2-second end card. Preserve the source video's aspect ratio and framing. From 0.000 to 7.000 seconds reproduce the ENTIRE supplied source clip, in order at original speed, preserving its original visuals and original soundtrack as faithfully as possible. Do not trim any source footage, shorten it, add transitions, or place text over the source clip. At exactly 7.000 seconds hard-cut to a solid black end card that lasts until 9.000 seconds. On this card only, display exactly two lines of crisp white text: first line 'Ready for takeoff?' and second line '@flightschool'. Center-align both lines horizontally and center the two-line group vertically. Use a clean readable sans-serif font. Keep the end card static and completely silent: no music, speech, ambient noise, or sound effects from 7.000 through 9.000 seconds. No fade or other transition. The source clip's original audio must remain throughout the first 7 seconds only.
